# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** … and the Divine Order proce eding from Good … exce eds … the infl ux of divine truth flowing through them .

**¶3:** This principle , which was recognized as "confirmed in Good " — the inn um erable goods and truths dwelling in the states of Wisdom confirmed it among themselves . The manif old forms of good and truth in those states set it apart, and it went forth against the power of evil and falsity. They gave this essential quality … this substance …which are manif old, dwelling in the states of Wisdom, and which are beyond all measure or enum eration.

**¶4:** This principle, which was recognized as "Divine Order itself ," because it is the first and original Good in which no fals ity has any part , among all the states belonging to Wisdom and to the interior thought … they perceived its quality …because it is the first principle that proceeded from the Divine Good itself, who sent it forth bearing five forms of perception into the realm of spiritual destruction .

**¶5:** This principle also , which was recognized as "the sole truth proceeding directly from Good ," because it was established …to pour forth …against the power of fals ity.

**¶7:** … the sole truth proceeding from Good, formed also from celest ial good and spiritual truth and all the interior qualities of the created order .

**¶8:** Just as Divine Love itself , proce eding into the ou termost degree, stood firm in its own order amid all the states of fals ity and evil — it did not inc line toward fals ity, nor was it drawn into the desire of evil . Rather, its wisdom and its love were directed wholly in ward toward those in states of good belonging to its own spiritual household. Whatever the power of evil attempted through its violence — be hold, the Divine lab ors and cont ends so that evil may be separated from those who are its own, and fals ity cast out from among them. And it purifies them, and rest ores them to spiritual freedom , and brings them back into the celestial state they possessed from their origin .

**¶10:** … the perpet ual presence of Divine Love directed toward those of its own spiritual household, as it remains with them in states of obscurity and in states of clarity alike , without ce asing.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [...] and the [righte]o[usness of the Father] is more than [the power of] the voice through them.

This one, whom they called "approved" [, the reason they gave him this name is that] they approved him in the midst of the ae[ons of] light. These numerous multitudes set him a[part], and he came forth against the enemy. They gave this name [to him on account of] this matter [: the aeons] who are numerous, that are in the aeons of light and who [are without] measure or number.

This one, [whom they called] "righteous", because he is the first righteous one who had no sin amongst all of the aeons that belong to the light and the thought [of the Father. And] they knew him, so that [he came forth from the Father of Greatness, who sent him with his five sons to the land of darkness.]

Again, just as the only begotten ones from your [only] begotten race and you [are formed] according to flesh [, so is the o]nly begot-ten also from gold and silver and all the [treasures] of the universe.

[the F]irst Man, himself stood firm in the [midst] of all the worlds of darkness. He did not love [the] worlds of darkness, nor did he lust for them! Rather, h[is] thought and love for the household of his people is in h[i]m. Anything else that the enemy [wrought was] with his violent de[e]ds. Behold, (the First Man) toils and struggles; so that (the enemy) would be separat[ed from] them and be cast out from them. And he purifies them and ma[ke]s them f[r]ee, and makes them as they were from the beginning.
